Upon casting <arc/>Gathering Storm:
• Releases lightning at enemies within ? meters of you, dealing <pve 650 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and <arc/>Jolting them
• You and allies within ? meters become <arc/>Amplified

Lightning strikes (inconsistently) refund up to 50% Super Energy on <arc/>Arc-Debuffed enemy Hits or Kills based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
//• Enemy Players: %
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% on Hits | ? on Kills
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: ?% | ?%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?% | ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25?% | ?%

<arc/>Arc-Debuffed enemy Kills (inconsistently) grant additional <arc/>Gathering Storm Super Energy:
• Minors: 1%
• Elites: 2.5%
• Players, Minibosses and higher: 4%

Inconsistencies are only(?) observed with <arc/>Jolted enemies. Possibly due to killing enemies too fast after triggering <arc/>Jolt's damage.
